title: Stardew Valley
description: A charming farming sim where you build your dream farm, befriend villagers, and explore mysterious caves. Perfect for relaxing sessions.
tagline: Plant crops, raise animals, and create the farm of your dreams.

title: DELTARUNE
description: An incredible story-driven RPG from the creator of Undertale. Emotional narrative with memorable characters and tough choices.
tagline: A narrative adventure that will make you laugh and cry.

title: Megabonk
description: An intense platformer that tests your skills and reflexes. Every level is a new challenge that rewards precision and persistence.
tagline: Precision platforming at its finest - prepare to bonk!

title: SPORE
description: The classic creature creator and evolution simulator. Guide your species from cell to space-faring civilization.
tagline: Create, evolve, and conquer the galaxy.

title: Palia
description: A cozy community sim MMO where you can farm, fish, forage, and make friends in a welcoming fantasy world.
tagline: Build your dream home in a vibrant online community.

title: Hollow Knight
description: A challenging metroidvania with precise combat and gorgeous hand-drawn art. Explore a vast underground kingdom.
tagline: Descend into a beautiful, brutal world.

title: Celeste
description: A touching story about overcoming anxiety wrapped in tight platforming. Every death is a lesson, not a failure.

title: Final Fantasy IV
description: A legendary JRPG with an unforgettable story and soundtrack. Experience one of gaming's greatest adventures.
